reviews.question: Welche Wassereigenschaft misst Alba und mit welchem Licht? (Quelle: Alba · archive 3)
reviews.answer: Alba misst die Trübung mit grünem Licht bei 530 nm. cite [fixture 08, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-9393736aac972c9fc1a06581/1)

Alba - archive 8 The Alba sensor uses green light at 530 nm to measure turbidity. It does not measure oxygen concentration. Calibration is required every 30 days. *Source: Nodus QA synthetic archive.*
